title: Trend Kit
description: Produced by the optional trend-scan stage (d-192/d-199). trend-scout — story-blind — researches the internet's biggest live waves in any domain and proposes 10, ranked by audience size; the Director selects one/many/none; trend-weaver authors the integration plan (subtle, in-world, brand-safe) that stages 2 (story), 11 (publishing) and 12 (spotlights) consume.

researched_at.description: ISO date of the research pass — trends expire; re-scan if production starts >2 weeks later.

evidence.description: Where it is trending and how big — platform + concrete signal (views, hashtag volume, examples), with source URLs where possible.

fit_rationale.description: Mass-appeal rationale (d-199): why this wave commands huge attention and what audience it carries. The scout is story-blind — fit to the show is judged later by the Director (selection) and the weaver (integration).

risk.description: Honest downside: dating fast, kids-safety optics, copyright/music licensing, cringe potential.

selected_trend_ids.description: Empty array = Director chose NONE (legitimate outcome; stage closes with no integration).

integration.description: trend-weaver output — REQUIRED when selection is non-empty. The subtlety contract: the story must work for a viewer who has never seen the trend.

approach.description: HOW it lives in the story: a gag, a visual motif, a character bit, a location flavor, a musical wink — concrete, not 'reference the trend'.

subtlety_test.description: Written proof both ways: what a trend-aware viewer gains, AND why a trend-blind viewer loses nothing.

canon_impact.description: Any touch on locked canon/tone — must be none or Director-gated.

metadata_placements.description: Every click surface the trend should boost. Empty string/array = weaver judged that surface should NOT carry it (record why in notes).
